name: Interesting set 2

sprites.name: Lanturn
sprites.note: The two orbs give off light and light its head in the cave.

sprites.name: Steelix
sprites.note: Polished steel: it mirrors sky and grass in the field and goes silver in the studio.

sprites.name: Sableye
sprites.note: Eyes and chest gems are crystal; the eyes glow in the dark, as the Pokédex says.

sprites.name: Litwick
sprites.note: Wax lets light through; only the flame glows.

sprites.name: Magcargo
sprites.note: Lava body glows faintly; the flame and the cracks in its rock shell are the bright parts.

sprites.name: Vanillite
sprites.note: Snow head lets light through, so it turns warm by the torch; the body is ice.

sprites.name: Golett
sprites.note: Matte clay; the yellow energy in its chest and seams glows.

sprites.name: Bronzong
sprites.note: Old bronze: a dull reflection of the sky and grass, not a mirror.

note: Picked for what they are made of, to judge the approach.
